Real outputs from the owner's Mac (2026-11-08, Flutter 3.41.9, macOS arm64),
home folder replaced with `/Users/dev`.

* `flutter-doctor-v.txt`: `flutter doctor -v` in a terminal (lines wrapped).
* `flutter-doctor-v-nowrap.txt`: the same, as `flutter --no-wrap doctor -v`
  prints it (shortened to the Flutter and Android sections).
* `flutter-config-machine.json`: `flutter config --machine`.
* `hello.xz`: `frida-server test payload\n` compressed with xz (CRC64), like
  the frida-server releases.
